attributes.title: 2027 ABVP Symposium
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ABVP Symposium takes place April 1 to 4, 2027, at the Marriott Marquis Chicago. The American Board of Veterinary Practitioners runs it as a species-focused clinical meeting; registration categories include general veterinarians, ABVP diplomates and candidates, residents, students and a veterinary technician rate.

ABVP says the 2027 scientific program will be released in November 2026 and the early-bird deadline will be announced later; the rates currently shown are 2026 figures marked as subject to change, so we do not list them. The hotel rate is $279 per night until March 8, 2027.

The page links a New York State CE approval; total CE hours and RACE status for 2027 are not published yet.
